summary.text: SÆTREN AS is a private limited company registered in Måløy, founded 1984-12-12. SÆTREN AS is engaged in electrical installation and service activities for ships, industry, buildings and construction works. The company may also take interests in other companies if this can benefit the company. It was previously named SÆTREN INSTALLASJON AS until 2017-12-14. Its main industry code is 43.210: electrical installation. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 62 407 555 NOK and the annual result was 2 782 619 NOK; operating income was up from 57 131 574 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from 2 405 004 NOK in 2024 to 2 782 619 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 20 084 245 NOK in 2024 to 21 466 864 NOK in 2025. Its verified website is saetren.no, which links to its Facebook profile. It has 5 open positions listed, most recently "IKE-tekniker? Søk da vel!". The latest news on its own website is "Vi søker: PROSJEKTLEDER ELEKTRO" from 2026-10-08. The registered employee count went from 42 on 2026-01-14 to 45 on 2026-09-15. The register's most recent update was on 2026-09-15 (antallAnsatte, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteEnhetsregisteret, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteNAVAaregisteret).
